social_post.caption:
🦷 Brushing twice a day? Great! But are you doing it right?

Here's what we recommend:
• 2 minutes, twice daily
• Gentle circular motions
• Don't forget your tongue
• Replace brush every 3 months

Proper technique prevents cavities and gum disease better than brushing harder or longer.

Due for a checkup? We have appointments available this month.

📞 Schedule online or call us

#DentalHealth #OralHygiene #HealthySmile #DentalCare #PreventiveDentistry

email.subject: Your Dental Consultation - Available Appointments
email.body:
Dear Michael,

Thank you for your interest in teeth whitening at our practice.

Based on your inquiry, I'd recommend starting with a consultation to assess your current tooth shade and discuss the best whitening option for your goals. We offer both in-office professional whitening (1-2 visits) and custom take-home trays.

Consultations are complimentary, and we can typically see new patients within the week.

Available times this week:
- Wednesday 2:00 PM
- Thursday 10:00 AM
- Friday 3:30 PM

We accept most major insurance plans, and cosmetic procedures can be financed through our payment plan options.

Please let us know which time works best, or call us at (843) 555-0123.

Looking forward to meeting you!

Best regards,
Dr. Sarah Chen, DDS
Charleston Dental Care

review_reply.review_text: Dr. Chen and her team are wonderful! Very gentle and explained everything clearly. Highly recommend!
review_reply.response: Thank you so much for the kind review! We're thrilled that you had a positive experience with Dr. Chen and our team. Making sure our patients feel comfortable and informed is our top priority. We appreciate your trust in our care and look forward to seeing you at your next appointment!
